prompt: Describe your ideal Saturday in under 100 words. Every sentence must be independently American.
response: Wake up early and grab a tall drip coffee from the corner diner. Drive my pickup truck down the interstate with country radio blasting. Catch a college football tailgate with buddies, grilling burgers and hot dogs. Toss a baseball around in the park until the afternoon sun fades. Hit a drive-thru for a milkshake and fries on the way home. Watch a classic Western on the couch with a bowl of buttered popcorn. Fire up the backyard barbecue for ribs at sunset. End the night on the porch, sipping sweet tea under the stars and stripes.
